summary: Renewal of expired driving license with medical fitness certification for another 10 to 20 years.
estimated_total_cost: ₹200 renewal fee + ₹200 card fee (Late fee if expired > 1 year)

steps.title: Medical Form 1A certification
steps.description: For drivers aged 40 and above, registered MBBS doctor uploads Form 1A medical fitness certificate digitally on Sarathi.

steps.title: Apply on Sarathi portal
steps.description: Authenticate with Aadhaar, enter existing DL number and date of birth, and confirm residential address.

steps.title: Pay renewal charges online
steps.description: Pay fee online; no physical RTO visit needed if Aadhaar authentication is successful.

steps.title: RTO approval & printing
steps.description: RTO licensing officer approves digital file and sends for smart card embossing.

steps.title: Postal delivery
steps.description: Renewed driving license delivered to residential address via India Post Speed Post.
